failure_cases.old_claim: The Jills Zeder Group is a luxury real estate team operating in Miami, Florida, affiliated with Coldwell Banker Realty.
The team reports having closed over $13 billion in sales and was ranked as the #1 real estate team in the U.S.A. by RealTrends Verified in 2026.
The website provides options for users to contact the team, schedule consultations, and join a VIP list via contact forms that include SMS consent.
The Jills Zeder Group offers services to buyers and sellers, including property search, relocation assistance, and digital marketing strategies for luxury listings.
